title: The Null Invitation | ECHO//100 Episode 81
description: Kavi receives a key that unravels the fabric of his reality, forcing him to confront the truth about his home. He must choose between the comfort of a prison or the danger of the unknown. Episode 81 of ECHO//100: The Door War. This is an AI-assisted original-fiction work.

scenes.text: The key vibrates in Kavi’s palm, pulsing with a rhythmic, low-frequency hum defying physics.
scenes.caption: Key begins to hum
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi wearing a red hoodie and glasses, staring at a glowing, jagged metal key in his hand.

scenes.text: Suddenly, the front lawn dissolves into a violent, swirling vortex of jagged, multicolored static.
scenes.caption: Lawn turns to static
scenes.image_prompt: Wide shot of Kavi standing on his porch as the green grass transforms into a swirling digital static abyss.

scenes.text: Null stands motionless, his black-purple glitch form flickering like a dying signal amidst chaos.
scenes.caption: Null remains perfectly still
scenes.image_prompt: Null, a tall figure of shifting purple glitch patterns, stands calmly on the porch while the world behind him tears apart.

scenes.text: Null is no villain, but a custodian desperately holding the frayed timeline together by hand.
scenes.caption: Null is the custodian
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Null with glowing red eyes looking at Kavi, his hands glowing with golden light holding the air together.

scenes.text: He offers Kavi the choice: remain in this quiet house or enter the actual world.
scenes.caption: The ultimate choice
scenes.image_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from Kavi, looking at Null, who holds out a hand toward the swirling vortex.

scenes.text: Kavi looks back at the front door, realizing this home is a stagnant containment cell.
scenes.caption: House is a prison
scenes.image_prompt: Low angle shot of Kavi's house, its walls beginning to flicker and fade, revealing metallic bars hidden beneath the siding.

scenes.text: The safety of the loop was never meant to protect, but to stop Kavi.
scenes.caption: Breaking the cycle
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi standing firmly on the porch, his backpack straps pulled tight, looking at the house with sudden realization.

scenes.text: Kavi jams the key into empty air, tearing the sky open to reveal a city.
scenes.caption: City of floating clocks
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi thrusts the key into a rift in the sky, revealing a massive, impossible city of gold gears and floating clock towers.
